```{r setup}
library(here)
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = here::here())

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr); library(readr); library(purrr); library(glue)
  library(sf); library(terra); library(tidyterra)
  library(ggplot2); library(viridisLite); library(scales); library(MASS); library(knitr)
})

# Config drives which year/taxa/CRS the report uses — the same config the
# pipeline ran with. Edit config/config.R, not this document.
source(here("config", "config.R"))
source(here("config", "taxa_config.R"))
source(here("config", "sampling_config.R"))
source(here("R", "00_utils.R"))

report_year <- config$focal_year

# Which taxa actually have greedy outputs for this year?
greedy_dir <- function(taxon) file.path(
  taxon_output_dir(taxon), "sampling_optimized", as.character(report_year))
have <- config$taxa[vapply(config$taxa,
  function(t) file.exists(file.path(greedy_dir(t), "greedy_species_summary.csv")),
  logical(1))]
```

```{r no-outputs, results='asis'}
if (length(have) == 0) {
  cat(glue(
    "::: callout-warning\n",
    "No pipeline outputs found for **{report_year}**. Run the pipeline first ",
    "(e.g. `source('R/run_pipeline.R'); run_pipeline(sample = TRUE)`), then ",
    "re-render this report.\n:::\n"))
  knitr::knit_exit()
}
```

This report summarises, for **`r report_year`**, how many species meet their
range-sampling coverage target and where new sampling would do the most good.
Targets and priorities come straight from the pipeline's sampling-optimization
outputs.

## Species meeting sampling targets

A species "meets target" when at least `r scales::percent(sampling_params$target_sampling_frac)`
of its range is sampled (or reachable by the proposed sampling plan).

```{r targets-data}
targets <- purrr::map_dfr(have, function(t) {
  readr::read_csv(file.path(greedy_dir(t), "greedy_species_summary.csv"),
                  show_col_types = FALSE) |>
    dplyr::mutate(taxon = t)
})

by_taxon <- targets |>
  dplyr::group_by(taxon) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_species   = dplyr::n(),
    n_at_target = sum(target_met, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_at_target = round(100 * mean(target_met, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    .groups = "drop")

overall <- tibble::tibble(
  taxon = "all taxa",
  n_species = sum(by_taxon$n_species),
  n_at_target = sum(by_taxon$n_at_target),
  pct_at_target = round(100 * sum(by_taxon$n_at_target) / sum(by_taxon$n_species), 1))
```

```{r targets-table}
dplyr::bind_rows(by_taxon, overall) |>
  dplyr::rename(
    Taxon = taxon, Species = n_species,
    `At target` = n_at_target, `% at target` = pct_at_target) |>
  knitr::kable(align = "lrrr")
```

```{r targets-plot, fig.height=3.6}
ggplot(by_taxon, aes(x = reorder(taxon, pct_at_target), y = pct_at_target,
                     fill = taxon)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.65, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_text(aes(label = glue("{n_at_target}/{n_species}")),
            hjust = -0.15, size = 3.6) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "mako", begin = 0.25, end = 0.75) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 100), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.12))) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "% of species meeting target",
       title = glue("Species meeting sampling targets ({report_year})")) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
        panel.grid.major.y = element_blank())
```

## Sampling priority map

Each hex cell the optimizer selected is a candidate new sampling location. The
map below is a kernel-density surface of those cells, weighted by how many
undersampled species each would help cover — brighter areas are higher priority.

```{r priority-map, fig.height=8}
# Region outline + conservation cells from the shared spatial layers.
region <- sf::st_read(config$paths$hex_grid, quiet = TRUE) |>
  sf::st_union() |> sf::st_transform(config$crs$equal_area)

cons <- tryCatch(
  sf::st_read(config$paths$cons_areas_hex, quiet = TRUE) |>
    sf::st_transform(config$crs$equal_area),
  error = function(e) NULL)

# All selected cells across taxa for this year.
selected <- purrr::map_dfr(have, function(t) {
  f <- file.path(greedy_dir(t), "greedy_selected_cells.gpkg")
  if (file.exists(f)) sf::st_read(f, quiet = TRUE) |>
    dplyr::transmute(n_spp_covered) |> dplyr::mutate(taxon = t)
}) |> sf::st_transform(config$crs$equal_area)

cents <- sf::st_centroid(selected)
xy <- sf::st_coordinates(cents)
df <- tibble::tibble(X = xy[, 1], Y = xy[, 2],
                     w = pmax(1, cents$n_spp_covered))
# Weight the KDE by species covered (repeat points by weight).
dfw <- df[rep(seq_len(nrow(df)), df$w), ]

bb <- sf::st_bbox(region)
kde <- MASS::kde2d(dfw$X, dfw$Y, n = 300,
                   lims = c(bb["xmin"], bb["xmax"], bb["ymin"], bb["ymax"]))
r <- terra::rast(list(x = kde$x, y = kde$y, z = kde$z))
terra::crs(r) <- config$crs$equal_area
mm <- terra::minmax(r); r <- (r - mm[1]) / (mm[2] - mm[1])
r <- terra::mask(r, terra::vect(region))
names(r) <- "priority"

p <- ggplot() +
  geom_spatraster(data = r) +
  geom_spatraster_contour(data = r, color = "white", alpha = 0.4,
                          linewidth = 0.3, bins = 10) +
  geom_sf(data = region, fill = NA, color = "grey30", linewidth = 0.4)
if (!is.null(cons)) {
  p <- p + geom_sf(data = cons, fill = NA, color = "grey55",
                   linewidth = 0.2, alpha = 0.5)
}
p +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "inferno", direction = -1,
                       name = "Relative\npriority", labels = scales::percent,
                       na.value = "transparent", limits = c(0, 1)) +
  coord_sf(expand = FALSE) +
  labs(title = glue("Sampling-priority areas ({report_year})")) +
  theme_void(base_size = 12) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5,
                                  margin = margin(b = 6)),
        plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
        legend.key.height = unit(1.1, "cm"))
```

```{r priority-note, results='asis'}
cat(glue(
  "The optimizer selected **{nrow(selected)}** candidate cells across ",
  "{length(have)} taxa for {report_year}. Higher-priority areas concentrate ",
  "where many undersampled species' ranges overlap.\n"))
```
